_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real (0-for-35 on ±2 moves) and no breaker is visible, so HOLD with conviction is the graded call — but the 76.8% bottom analog and stealth liquidity build suggest the snap, when it comes, is more likely UP into Disbelief than DOWN into Panic.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil; narrative implies directional LONG is warranted by the bottom analog. Judge sides with analyst on direction (HOLD) but with narrative on asymmetry (upside skew).
next_move.confirmed_if: Score breaks above 62 with btc_momentum_30d climbing above 60 and eth_etf_flows sustaining above 90
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks below 54 with vix spiking above 20 and funding flipping negative
